The Zamorak cape can be imbued with the items dropped by [[Justiciar Zachariah]], [[Porazdir]], and [[Derwen]], during the [[Mage Arena II]] [[miniquest]] to make an [[imbued Zamorak cape]]. Subsequent imbues will require only the [[Demon's heart]].

Like the other max cape variants (a max cape combined with another [[cape slot]] item), the Saradomin max cape does not have the max cape's stats or perks; it only acts as a cosmetic upgrade to the Saradomin cape with the following exceptions when worn:

If the player is skulled and has the Protect Item prayer active, both the max cape and their most valuable item will be kept. cases.title: Scorching bow
cases.semanticExcerpt: The '''scorching bow''' is a [[demonbane weapon]] requiring level 77 [[Ranged]] to wield. It is made by using a [[tormented synapse]] on a [[magic longbow (u)]]. This requires level 74 [[Fletching]] (boostable) and having read [[Duradel's notes]] after completion of [[While Guthix Sleeps]].
secondaryExcerpts: The bow, able to fire arrows up to [[dragon arrows]], has a 30% accuracy and damage bonus against [[Demon (attribute)|demonic]] creatures. Similar to the [[dragon hunter crossbow]], the damage bonus is applied additively with the 15% damage boost from a [[slayer helmet (i)]] or [[black mask (i)]], resulting in a total damage boost of 45%.

The process to create the scorching bow can be reversed via the 'Revert' option, returning only the tormented synapse as a result. A [[player killer]] will receive the synapse from their opponent if it is not one of their protected items.
The scorching bow cannot be used to light a fire with [[Barbarian Training#Firemaking|Barbarian Firemaking]].
